question: 不同支付方式在2025年8月的退款率分布情况（退款金额÷当月销售额，退款时间在2025-08的记录对应的退款金额除以这些订单下单月份（2025-08）的销售额）
gold_sql:
SELECT o.pay_type, SUM(r.refund_amount) * 1.0 /
    (SELECT SUM(o2.total_amount) FROM orders o2
     WHERE o2.pay_type = o.pay_type
       AND substr(o2.order_time, 1, 7) = '2025-08'
       AND o2.status IN ('已完成', '已退款'))
    AS refund_ratio
FROM orders o JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE substr(r.refund_time, 1, 7) = '2025-08'
  AND r.status = '已退款'
GROUP BY o.pay_type
raw_output:
SELECT 
    o.pay_type,
    SUM(r.refund_amount) / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_time) = '2025-08' THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS refund_rate
FROM 
    refunds r
JOIN 
    orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE 
    strftime('%Y-%m', r.refund_time) = '2025-08'
GROUP BY 
    o.pay_type;
